subtitle: Band 8.0-9.0 Academic Reading & Lexical Resource Assessment for International University Candidates.
instructions: CBT Academic Reading Style: 40 seconds per question.
Lexical Resource: Focuses on precision, collocations, and register.
Select the most appropriate academic word.

questions.prompt: In academic environmental reports, plastic debris is described as ________ in marine ecosystems, meaning it can be detected across all oceanic strata.
questions.explanation: 'Ubiquitous' indicates presence everywhere simultaneously, standard in high-band IELTS environmental essays.

questions.prompt: The research supervisor insisted that all dissertation conclusions be presented in a ________ manner to prevent ambiguity among international peer reviewers.
questions.explanation: 'Lucid' means clear, rational, and easily understood, avoiding ambiguity.

questions.prompt: Policymakers decided on a ________ infrastructure plan, prioritizing immediate public transit fixes over speculative multi-decade megaprojects.
questions.explanation: 'Pragmatic' implies realistic, practical problem solving based on current conditions.
